theorems.name: Submission.ltg_simple_unit_rigidity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (τ τ' : Fin k → Eucl P) (w w' : NVector (Eucl P) k) (a a' : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ τ' → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → (w' = simpleNVector τ' ∨ w' = -simpleNVector τ') → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ a' → a • w = a' • w' → a = a' ∧ (a ≠ 0 → w = w')
